lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: All right... so South City is to the North, North City is to the West, and East City is... also to the North.
The coach radio is tuned to a music station
Music continues to play despite the crash

lines.speaker: Coach Roger
lines.text: Sir, I need to ask you to move off the road.

lines.speaker: Coach Roger
lines.text: We have a very important game today against the West City Southerners and we're already running late.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: (Gasp) 'Aww, East City has a Panda Sanctuary, that's cute.'

lines.speaker: Coach Roger
lines.text: I am now going to start applying the horn.

lines.speaker: Coach Roger
lines.text: I am *now* going to use it again.

lines.speaker: Coach Roger
lines.text: I will now continue to use the horn until you *politely* move!
HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK HONK

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: 'Now, I just need to find my brother and sister before--'

lines.speaker: Bucko
lines.text: Hey, ya giant green pylon! You ain't no car, so get off the road!

lines.speaker: Bucko
lines.text: Else me and the boys are gonna have ta make yer face look like yer ass, and yer ass look like yer face!

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Mmm... (inhales)... hey you, I wanna make a joke about your team. What's its name?

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: 'Oh, I am too hungry for this *shit*.'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wow, Piccolo's pulling a your dad.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You! Namekian! Too strong! Explain now!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: He fused with Kami so he could become stronger.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Do you really believe your own hype that much?!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Hey, finally found you guys. Just followed Vegeta's screaming. What did I miss?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Oh, that finally came full circle.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: More importantly, there's a new threat: *Another* Android created by Dr. Gero!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: Everyone! You have to come quickly!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Aww, but we're about to drink our lima bean and lentil smoothies.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: Eh, they taste like vomit but they keep me regular. I'm like a soft-serve ice cream machine in the mornin'!

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: No time for those! Come upstairs!

lines.speaker: Oolong
lines.text: What a miracle we have witnessed. Allow me to go call the local news.

lines.speaker: Chi-Chi
lines.text: I've had to deal with him screaming bloody murder for the last three hours; I'll take what I can get.

lines.speaker: Roshi
lines.text: I wonder what he's dreamin' about...

lines.speaker: Monkey D. Luffy
lines.text: Yay! I'm Pirate Goku! Are you ready for an adventure, Sword-Guy Piccolo?

lines.speaker: Roronoa Zoro
lines.text: Uh, actually, I think you need to wake up. The Androids are--

lines.speaker: Naruto Uzumaki
lines.text: Hey, Pirate Goku! Let's go on an adventure!

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So yeah, that's basically it in a nutshell.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: So if Cell manages to find whatever he's missing, he'll become even stronger?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: I guess? He was pretty vague about it; no matter what though - if he and the Androids join forces... none of us will stand a chance.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I don't care how many people you fuse with. You'll never be as strong as a Super Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Not really much of a milestone anymore.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: As for me, I will find a level *beyond* a Super Saiyan!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: So, what? Like a Mega Saiyan? *Ultra* Saiyan?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Why do you antagonize him like that? You know he can kill you, right?

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: At this point, it's a game. If he gives in, I win... and he knows that.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Crazy thought - if that Cell's from another timeline, then's there gotta be one in this timeline too.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Pretty sure that *emotional episode* you had earlier levelled Gero's lab.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, he was a mad scientist. Shot in the dark - maybe he's got a basement?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Alright then. Trunks, you go back to Gero's lab. I'm going after Cell.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I'm going with Trunks to go after Cell.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Aaand I'm going with, Piccolo to... go after... Cell...?

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: So, now that I have the chance to say this, um... sorry my Dad killed Chiaotzu.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Hey there, cherry. What's your name?

lines.speaker: Nicky Town
lines.text: My name is Nicky Town. Who are you?

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Name's Cell... [licks his, uh, orifice]... and you are lookin' fiiine.

lines.speaker: Nicky Town
lines.text: Well, thank you Mr. Cell, but you're just sayin' that.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Oh, I don't say that to *every* town I come across.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Oh don't worry, I'll get around to it.

lines.speaker: Nicky Town
lines.text: But I need you right *now*, Mr. Cell.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: OK-OK-OK, I'm in the middle of something right now--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: (Shivers)... oh my God, was it always this cold? We were here at noon, it was not this cold!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Well, if you need to warm up, start looking.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You know, I sometimes complain about our lifestyle, but honestly - shooting lasers is fun!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: All the time in my head. Why; is that weird?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, we can't climb down that - it's broken.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: I need to ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: If we find any more Androids down here... please don't tell my father.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: I swear on my life. Unless he threatens my life... in which case...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Hey, so, if I were a gambling man...

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: These... these are the schematics for the Androids! We could use these to find a way to turn them off!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: 'Don't ask how to turn them on.' 'Don't ask how to turn her on!' 'Don't ask how to turn Android 18 on!'

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: How do you turn Android 17 on?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Also, it lists their real names: "Lapis" and "Lazuli". And apparently, Android 16 was modeled after Gero's son!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Are you making that up? It sounds like you're making that up.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, OK. Grab those and let's kill Cell!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Technically, its never done anything wrong... so, doesn't it have the right to life?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: This isn't about a right to life...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: It's about making a choice. A choice we both need to make.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: A choice between a terrible mistake that can ruin lives, and--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: F**k it, I'm dropping the pretenses; we're aborting Cell!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Alright, let's get out of here before this place comes down on our heads.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Sorry, just a little caught up in gloating.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: That was fun! We should hang out more.

lines.speaker: Piccolo
lines.text: Nothing but clothes with stab marks. Cell's calling card.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Naw dammit, he killed my star battle back! My entire fantasy team just went straight to hell.

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Hey there, Nicky Town. This is your local station 98.5, *The Nick*, where TJ--

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: What's the weather looking like out there, Wombat?

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: We're in the middle of an impossible heat wave - a balmy 104 degrees - so make sure you stay hydrated! *Real* hydrated!

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: And in local sports news, many of our listeners are still waiting at the stadium for the East City Westmen, who are becoming increasingly late to the game. Probably hit some traffic on the turnpike...

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Oh, looks like we got our first call-in of the segment! Hello there, caller. What can TJ...

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: ...Ah, there. OK. Could you play "Video Killed the Radio Star"?

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Wow, uh, we usually only do the top 20...

lines.speaker: Wombat
lines.text: But today, we'll make an exception for you, *killer*!

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Dohh, shucks! Thanks, fellas! I'll be right in.
Imperfect Cell breaks into the studio

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: Oh, God...! Oh, God! WHAT IS THAT THING?! NO! NO, GET AWAY! GET AWAY FROM WOMBAT! NO! PUT HIM DOWN!

lines.speaker: TJ
lines.text: NO-HO-HO! WHY, GOD?! OHHHH GOD, I LOVED YOU, WO-HOMBA-HA-HAT!! I LOVED YOU SO MUCH!! GAH! OH, MY GUHH--
♫ Pictures came and broke your heart ♫

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Hey, welcome back to 98.5, The Cell. We have another caller making a request...

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Sorry, that's not in the lineup.

lines.speaker: Imperfect Cell
lines.text: Speaking of the lineup, in the next half-hour, we've got: "Hungry Like the Wolf" by Duran Duran, "Killing Me Softly With His Song" by Lauren Hill, followed by "All By Myself" (by Eric Carmen).

segments.title: Where the F**k Am I?
segments.quote: South City is to the North, North City is to the West, and East City is... also to the North. Where the f**k am I?

segments.title: Applying the Horn
segments.quote: I am now going to start applying the horn. / Beep!

segments.title: The East City Westmen
segments.quote: Hey you, I wanna make a joke about your team. What's its name? / The East City Westmen! / 'Oh, I am too hungry for this *shit*.'

segments.title: I AM THE HYPE
segments.quote: Do you really believe your own hype that much?! / I AM THE HYPE!!

segments.title: Pirate Goku's Dream
segments.quote: Yay! I'm Pirate Goku! Are you ready for an adventure, Sword-Guy Piccolo?

segments.title: You Mean a Nutcell
segments.quote: You mean a nut*cell*-- / Shut up!

segments.title: Maximum Over-Saiyan
segments.quote: So, what? Like a Mega Saiyan? *Ultra* Saiyan? ... *Maximum* Over-Saiyan! / F**k off, Triclops!

segments.title: Nicky Town
segments.quote: Mr. Cell, please absorb me. ... *BITCH I DO WHAT I WANT*!!

segments.title: Pe-Choo! Laser Noises
segments.quote: Shooting lasers is fun! Pe-choo! Pe-choo! Pe-choo!

segments.title: We're Aborting Cell
segments.quote: F**k it, I'm dropping the pretenses; we're aborting Cell!

segments.title: I Killed Cell
segments.quote: III~ KILLED CELLLLL~! / Hasta la vista, baby! / Probably should've backed up first...

segments.title: I Loved You, Wombat
segments.quote: NO! GET AWAY FROM WOMBAT! ... OHHHH GOD, I LOVED YOU, WO-HOMBA-HA-HAT!!
